The Data Center Advisory Committee, created alongside the moratorium, continues to meet (inaugural meeting 2026-09-17) and is unaffected by the ruling. Separately, a different judge (L. Brooks Anderholt) has ordered a full CEQA environmental review of the underlying data center project in a related case, so the project itself remains stalled notwithstanding the moratorium's invalidation.
